lines.text: Sheba son of Bichri blew the ram's horn, and all the men of Israel deserted David to follow him.
David confined his ten concubines in a house under guard, then told Amasa to summon Judah within seven days.
At the great stone in Gibeon, Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard and stabbed him with a dagger.
Joab's troops besieged Sheba in Mahanaim and built a siege ramp against the outer rampart of the city.
The people cut off Sheba's head and threw it to Joab, who blew the ram's horn and returned to Jerusalem.
